item.title: Carjack Consecutive Interpreting Scenario (English-Arabic)
item.description: dc.title: Carjack Consecutive Interpreting Scenario (English-Arabic) dc.description.abstract: Overview: This is a consecutive interpreting scenario for interpreter practice purposes. In the recording, a male prosecutor examines a female witness in a carjack case. Instructions for use: Use the recording to practice consecutive interpreting in the legal setting. Record your performance and compare it to the text after you finish. It is recommended to repeat the exercise as many times as needed.
